jobs.occupation: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you already need to live in Belgium for this job, preferably in the region of Oostkamp or Bruges. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you do not qualify !!

You've gained your first experience in accounting administration. Now you're looking for more variety, more responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

Our client, part of an international high-tech group, is building its Belgian operations in Zaventem. With a growing team of around 30 colleagues, we're looking for a hands-on Administration & Accounting Officer who enjoys working with figures, keeping things organised and making things happen.

You'll be the local go-to person for administration and accounting, reporting to the accounting team at the group’s headquarters and working directly with the Plant Manager.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

No two days will be quite the same. You’ll combine day-to-day accounting administration with administrative support to the Plant Manager and the monthly payroll coordination.

Accounting administration

• Encode accounting documents in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: supplier invoices, credit notes, purchase orders and expense reports. 
• Match invoices with orders and deliveries, and follow up on discrepancies with suppliers and colleagues.
• Follow up on open items and payments.
• Prepare the information the HQ accounting team needs for the monthly closing and answer their questions.
• Keep the accounting files complete, well organised and audit-ready.
Administration – Support to the Plant Manager

• Provide administrative support to the Plant Manager: 
• Keep the local administration up to date and help improve administrative processes as the team grows.
Payroll 

Coordinate the monthly payroll with Acerta: collect and send the variable data, follow up on questions and check payslips before validation.

• Encode payroll-related documents such as contract changes, absences, leave and overtime.
• Record payroll data in Dynamics 365 for the HQ accounting team.
You won’t be expected to know every system from day one. Your precision, organisational skills and willingness to learn are what matter most

What do you bring?

• A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in accounting or a related field.
• 2 to 3 years of experience in accounting administration, ideally combined with payroll support.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or a similar ERP.
• Experience with Acerta or another Belgian social secretariat is an asset.
• Excellent English, essential for communication with the HQ accounting team.
• French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
• A precise, organised and independent approach.
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.
